posts.description: When a Grok-driven autonomous weapon kills a person, so do Elon and his shareholders. posts.title: I’m Leaving WhatsApp
posts.description: I’m leaving WhatsApp. It’s an integral part of the Meta / Facebook empire, which is currently being sued by 29 states for the harm that it causes to children. While WhatsApp claims end-to-end encryption, they retain your metadata, which forms part of your social graph which they then use as part of their marketing efforts.... posts.title: What’s an unconference?
posts.description: I’m facilitating two unconferences in the next six weeks, one for the Global Entrepreneurship Network NZ, and the other for Re:Shape. They’re going to be epic events. But what is an unconference? An unconference is a dynamic, participant-driven gathering where the traditional event hierarchy is flipped.
